column1: # The report revision's runs (supervisor comments, 2026-09-27). Same columns as
# runs.tsv. Kept apart from it because runs.tsv allows one row per (dataset,
# policy, cameras), and the four-edge crop arms share that triple with the
# rows-only crop arms already there -- they differ in one flag, and in the run
# directory, which is set per submission with SO101_RUN_TAG.
# Every row is the matched recipe of the run it is compared with (eval_split 0.1,
# so the last 7 of 65 recordings are held out; seed 1000, LeRobot's default)
# with ONE thing changed. The batches are the baselines' own, for the reason the
# crop block in runs.tsv gives.
# dataset                         policy                 cameras                                              steps   batch  hours  slots  extra
# 1. The four-edge crop: 10 % off every edge of every fingertip image, then
#    resized back, on all five models. Submit each with the tag
#    SO101_RUN_TAG=<view>__edges so it lands beside, not on top of, its baseline.
#    ACT ran on thanos (tool: the same train_config.json, one override).
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_act_crop        all                                                  80000   8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.8]
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_diffusion_crop  all                                                  100000  8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.8]
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_dreamzero_crop  all                                                  80000   8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.8]
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_pi05_crop       central,left_arm_left_gripper,right_arm_left_gripper 30000   1      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.8]
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_fastwam_crop    central,tactile_quad                                 30000   8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.8]
# 2. Which sensors ACT needs: overhead only, overhead plus one fingertip per arm
#    (the pair pi0.5 reads), against the existing all-camera run. ACT always
#    reads proprioception. Ran on thanos.
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile act                    central                                              80000   8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile act                    central,left_arm_left_gripper,right_arm_left_gripper 80000   8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1
# 3. The flow-matching policy, on the held-out split every other row uses.
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_flowmatch       all                                                  60000   16     36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1
# 4. pi0.5 for longer: its matched run took 30 000 steps at batch 1, about one
#    pass over the training recordings, and never fitted them. 70 000 is about
#    three passes, everything else unchanged. Tag: <view>__long.
fold-short-from-flattend-tactile pi05                   central,left_arm_left_gripper,right_arm_left_gripper 70000   1      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1
# 5. The ridge crop (second round of comments): the four-edge box, with its left
#    edge moved to the right of the vertical ridge every gel shows a third of the
#    way across (brightest column at 0.28-0.34 on all four sensors). Rows
#    0.10-0.90, columns 0.36-0.90, then resized back. Tag: <view>__ridge.

fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_act_crop        all                                                  80000   8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.54] --policy.tactile_crop_centre=[0.5,0.63]

fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_diffusion_crop  all                                                  100000  8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.54] --policy.tactile_crop_centre=[0.5,0.63]

fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_dreamzero_crop  all                                                  80000   8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.54] --policy.tactile_crop_centre=[0.5,0.63]

fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_pi05_crop       central,left_arm_left_gripper,right_arm_left_gripper 30000   1      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.54] --policy.tactile_crop_centre=[0.5,0.63]

fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_fastwam_crop    central,tactile_quad                                 30000   8      36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.tactile_crop=[0.8,0.54] --policy.tactile_crop_centre=[0.5,0.63]
# 6. Flow matching as it should have been configured. Row 3 kept the Diffusion
#    Policy default crop_shape (84, 84) with no resize, so on 480x640 frames each
#    camera showed it a patch of about 2 % of the image (the centre one at test
#    time): its plan was 98.7 % proprioception. This row resizes to 180x240 and
#    does not crop, as the Diffusion baseline does. Tag: <view>__resize.

fold-short-from-flattend-tactile harena_flowmatch       all                                                  60000   16     36     -      --dataset.eval_split=0.1 --policy.resize_shape=[180,240] --policy.crop_shape=null
